issues: Console hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — caused by Visual Editor instrumentation wrapping option children in <span> with style display:contents. Pre-existing and not our code (the wrapper is x-excluded='true' Visual-Editor markup); no functional impact, select works and value updates correctly, but it produces a noisy React hydration warning in prod.

critical_code_review_comments: checkoutPrefetch.js: pfConfig/pfPickups/pfBank/pfCountries/pfGeo cache never expires within a session. Fine for a warm-up cache (immutable data), but if the merchant changes courier config in admin the storefront won't pick it up until reload — consider a TTL or bust the cache when settings mutate.

PreCheckoutModal.jsx: dialTouched is a ref reset from saved.current at mount; if the user clears localStorage in another tab and reopens the modal in this tab, dialTouched still reflects the pre-clear state until reload. Low-risk.

server.py serve_file: WebP/JPEG variant is written to disk but content is a plain read on the request thread — a very large upload could block the event loop. Consider running the PIL work in a thread pool for images over a few MB.

server.py serve_file: 'Vary: Accept' is set only on the final response headers; if an upstream/edge CDN caches without normalising Accept it could serve WebP to non-WebP clients. Confirm ingress/CDN respects Vary — the header is correct on origin.
